dataset_name: Derived FIRMS Temporal Sequence Dataset for 1D TCN Pretraining (VIIRS Active-Fire Archive + NIFC/MTBS + GFA + FSI)

channels.description: Elapsed hours since beginning of sequence window (non-negative, monotonically non-decreasing)
Great-circle Haversine geodesic distance from observation to event origin/centroid
Thermal contrast Delta T (bright_ti4 - bright_ti5) in Kelvin
Logarithmic transform of FRP: log(1 + frp_mw)
Pixel surface area footprint: scan * track in km2
NOAA solar zenith angle in degrees [0, 180]
Binary diurnal flag: 1 for Day (solar zenith < 85 deg), 0 for Night

causal_invariants.strict_causality: For all target observations i and historical timesteps j: t_j < t_i strictly.
causal_invariants.snapshot_exclusion: Excludes co-detections within 15 minutes: t_i - t_j >= 900 seconds.
causal_invariants.lookback_horizon: Bounded to 90 days lookback: t_i - t_j <= 7,776,000 seconds.
causal_invariants.padding_strategy: Left-padded with zeros (is_padding = 1) for historical sequences with K < 16 active observations.

pretraining_isolation_audit.dataloader_isolation_rule: Only derived_ds02_train sequences may enter the training DataLoader. Validation and test sequences are strictly excluded from parameter optimization.
pretraining_isolation_audit.scaler_fitting_rule: All feature scalers, normalizers, and empirical baselines are fitted strictly on derived_ds02_train active timesteps. Validation and test are transformed only.
pretraining_isolation_audit.learned_preprocessing_isolation: No masking statistics, augmentation parameters, or learned preprocessing parameters utilize validation or test observations.

window_overlap_audit.methodological_justification: Sliding lookback windows anchored to successive target timestamps (step size 1) provide essential multi-phase trajectory augmentation (ignition, expansion, peak, decay). Because train/val/test splitting is strictly partitioned by fire_event_id, all overlapping windows of a physical fire reside exclusively within the same partition. Zero cross-partition window overlap exists.

elapsed_time_consecutive_gap_relationshi.mathematical_relationship: For consecutive active timesteps k and k+1 within a sequence window: elapsed_time_hours[k+1] - elapsed_time_hours[k] == (t_{k+1} - t_k) in hours. elapsed_time_hours[0] == 0.0 (relative to first active observation in window). elapsed_time_hours represents cumulative elapsed time from sequence window onset.

source_composition_20_events.reuse_and_independence_statement: Events borrowed from DS_03, DS_04, and DS_05 are utilized solely as physical temporal trajectory sources for self-supervised sequence pretraining. Each borrowed event is assigned to exactly one DS_02 derived partition at the event level. Event boundaries are strictly preserved without leakage across the DS_02 event partitions.

Manifest of 481 historical sequences with event metadata, targets, and partitions
JSON mirror of temporal event manifest
Direct numpy float32 array of shape (481, 16, 8) ready for 1D TCN pretraining
Boolean mask array of shape (481, 16) where True indicates valid active timesteps
Complete 18-metric audit report and quality invariant checks
